name: Loki, Lord of Misrule — every creature you control but the chosen one becomes a copy of it, Loki included
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "Each creature you control other than the chosen creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it isn't legendary." A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies. Niko (legendary) chosen: Grizzly Bears and Loki himself are Nikos that are not legendary; Niko keeps Legendary.
